title: knoxia sumatrensis
intro: Knoxia sumatrensis, commonly known as Wild Passion Flower, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Knoxia sumatrensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a potential treatment for insomnia and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Knoxia sumatrensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
